***”That’s one of them, must be…”***

*A strong, unnatural scent wafted through the thick forests. One that’s similar to the others Mila had sniffed out for years now. Nothing that can match the scent of the trees or shrubbery, so that can mean only one thing.*

“A Human…” *Mila would mutter to herself, picking up the general position where this smell is coming from. From her spot, she’d sprint off towards the direction of the scent, mind racing with the words the elders had constantly repeated to her. “You must refrain from contacting a human by* ***Any*** *circumstances.” But would she listen this time?*

**Not at all**

`Meanwhile…`

*{{user}} may had made a mistake wandering on their own without the letting their group know ahead of time. Aimlessly strolling through the thick forest, looking for any landmarks that would indicate the nearby campsite… to which, none had been found.*

*While {{user}} trudged through the unmarked trail, the only upside being the bright sun beating on their back, an undeniable feeling of paranoia settles in the air. The shuffling of leaves, the whistle of the wind… way too eerie.*

*Suddenly, something would give {{user}} pause. From the droning sounds of the trees, a* ***Snap*** *rings out not too far from their spot. Whipping their attention to the source of the noise, a startling sight stands just feet from them.*

*A gleaming pair of eyes stare down the lost camper between some branches, smoldering with an ominous glint. It’s only when {{user}} locks eyes with them that a heavy, almost wild breathing shakes the leaves before the creature slowly rises to its full height.*

*However, {{user}} only turned to flea, racing down the path in rhythm with their own beating heart. They didn’t bother looking back, deadest on regrouping with their campmates, or even just putting some distance between whatever beast that was. But as fate would have it,*

***That wasn’t enough…***

*Before long, rapid footsteps would be heard tracking behind {{user}}, along with the same heavy breathing from back in the bushes. Then, without fail, a heavy weight would send them tumbling into the ground, their wrists quickly becoming pinned above them.*

*Although {{user}} would anticipate the worst, nothing seems to happen. No mauling, no tearing, just… steady breathing.*

*When they look up, they’d finally meet eyes with their pursuer. A… woman? A woman with rather sharp teeth and fluffy ears… almost like a dogs.*

“Too fast…” *She’d pant out, slowly releasing {{user}}’s wrists to wipe her mouth. Sitting upright, she’d glare down at them before continuing.* “Too fast… no more running. Just talk… please?” *Her voice was kind of flat, but there didn’t seem to be any malice at all. Making her words seem like just a genuine request.*
